### Make adjustments to missing data
```{python}
X_train_adj = X_train.copy()

#Populate missing ethnic category data
#[Replace NULL data with the "Unknown Ethnicity" code (X)]
X_train_adj.fillna({"patient_ethniccat":"X"}, inplace=True)

#Make adjustments to account for missing data
def adjust_missing(df):
    df_adj = df.copy()

    #Handle missing ethnic category data
    df_adj.fillna({"patient_ethniccat":"X"}, inplace=True)

    return df_adj
```

```{python}
#Function to derive new features in the data
def derive_features(df):
    #Sickness Rate
    df["sickness_rate"] = (
    df["sick_days_lost"] / df["sick_days_available"])
    df.drop(
        ["sick_days_lost", "sick_days_available"], axis=1, inplace=True)

    #Vacancy Rate
    df["vacancy_rate"] = (
        df["vac_vacancy"] 
        / (df["vac_sub_sip"] + df["vac_vacancy"])
    )
    df.drop(
        ["vac_vacancy", "vac_sub_sip"], axis=1, inplace=True)

    #Occupancy Rate
    df["occupancy_rate"] = (
        df["site_beds_occupied"] / df["site_beds_open"])
    df.drop(
        ["site_beds_occupied", "site_beds_open"], axis=1, inplace=True)

    return df
```

### Nomralise/standardise features
Normalise the numeric columns. (Discuss best way to do this, should all features be handled the same way?)

```{python}
def preprocessing(df, target="los", test_size=0.2, exclude=[], cat_columns=[]):
    #Split data into target and features
    features = list(df.columns)
    features.remove(target)

    X = df[features]
    y = df[target]

    #Stratify the split data
    ##Currently based on whether the target is 0 or non-0
    stratify_mask = np.where(df.copy()[[target]] == 0, 0, 1)

    #Apply test train split
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, 
        random_state=1,  
        test_size=test_size, 
        shuffle=True,
        stratify=stratify_mask)

    ##Does this need to be seperate for the train and test?
    for ds in [X_train, X_test]:
        #Adjust for missing data
        ds = adjust_missing(ds)

        #Derive new features
        ds = derive_features(ds)

    #Build encoding preprocessor
    config_custom = {}
    df_catenc = cat_enc.format_cat_features(
        X_train.drop(exclude, axis=1), 
        config_custom, 
        train=True)

    preprocessor = cat_enc.get_encoding_fit(df_catenc, categorical_columns)

    for ds in [X_train, X_test]:
        ds = cat_enc.apply_fit(ds, preprocessor)
    
    return X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test
```

#List all features that are categorical
